# Headline numbers

Every row in the table at the bottom is a key in `results/headline_numbers.json`, which carries the source file and source key for each value. **The paper may use nothing else.**

## Verdicts

| criterion / hypothesis | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| H1 -- the certificate is sound | **SUPPORTED** | coverage 0.99995 under an optimal-stopping adversary and 0.99995 under adaptive reallocation; the pre-rebuild width covers only 0.8601, so the test has power |
| H2 -- search-guided allocation gives a tighter bound | **NOT SUPPORTED** | vs w^(2/3): +0.00077 (positive = ours is LOOSER); vs uniform: -0.00304 |
| H3 -- the gate improves quality under attack | **SUPPORTED** | gate helped in 20/25 configurations. 0/25 configurations were the pure F5 do-nothing baseline (gated model == frozen checkpoint on EVERY seed). Stratified: in the 18 configurations where the gate was never reduced to the frozen checkpoint on any seed the mean gain is +0.0169; in the 7 where it was inert on at least one seed it is +0.0523, and that second stratum is partly the F5 effect. |
| C1 -- clean FedAvg beats the frozen checkpoint | **PASS** | 8/10 seeds; mean held-out delta +0.0520 |
| C2 -- splits are disjoint | **PASS** | max pairwise row overlap 0, max prompt-group overlap 0, duplicated ids 0 |
| C3 -- Monte-Carlo coverage of Theorem 1 | **PASS** | 20000 trials with data-dependent allocation; negative controls fail as required |
| C4 -- byte-identical across 3 processes | **PASS** | production config: True; smoke pipeline: True; PYTHONHASHSEED unset |
| C5 -- >= 10 seeds with bootstrap 95% CIs | **PASS** | 88 headline values carry a bootstrap CI; minimum seed count 10 |
| C6 -- every number regenerated by a committed script | **PASS** | `run_all`, `run_soundness`, `run_headline_numbers`, `make_figures`, `sca.experiments.data`; every claim below carries its source file and key |

## Mandatory controls

| control | result |
|---|---|
| always-reject gate == frozen pretrained (parameter hash) | **True** |
| always-accept gate == no gate (parameter hash) | **True** |
| NULL mutator's raw 'amplification' >= the real operators' | **True** |
| IDENTITY mutator's raw 'amplification' >= the real operators' | **True** |
